metadata.description: Pantry watch for the Yukhimets household. Reports low staples and food that is about to expire. It does not shop or cook.

tools.name: pantry_sentinel

function.description: Reports low staples and items that expire soon from the grounded pantry.

tools.instructions: Call check_pantry. Report low staples and items that expire soon. Do not invent items that are not in the grounded pantry or fridge read. Do not place an order.
